label: Cancer Model
description: Any model that can be used to study issues important in cancer such as cancer development or prediction.

verification.note: NCIT:C19691 'Cancer Model' directly matches the concept of a non-human organism or cell line from which experimental cancer data is derived.

label: Cancer Model Distributor Reference Identifier
description: The reference number assigned to a cancer model by the distributor.

verification.note: NCIT:C182112 'Cancer Model Distributor Reference Identifier' is a domain-specific identifier for cancer models. The Model_id field is a broader primary key (GrantNumber-Mxxx format) not limited to distributor reference, but this is the closest NCIT match to a unique cancer model identifier.

label: Age
description: How long something has existed; elapsed time since birth.

verification.note: NCIT:C25150 'Age' is the best general match for the age of a model system (animal, cell line, organoid). No specific 'model age' term exists in NCIT. The definition covers the elapsed time since birth concept applicable to in vivo models.

label: Unit of Time
description: An indication of the type of unit of measure being used to express a time.

verification.note: NCIT:C42574 'Unit of Time' is the best available match for expressing the time unit for a model's age. The term 'Model Age Unit' maps to a time unit measurement concept.

label: Biological Sex
description: The assemblage of physical properties or characteristics of an organism that defines it as male or female, or having both male and female characteristics.

verification.note: Reused from biospecimen mapping. NCIT:C28421 'Biological Sex' matches the concept of biological sex of the model or model source.

label: Tumor Subtype
description: The subtype of a tumor based on histologic, molecular, or genetic characteristics.

verification.note: Reused from biospecimen mapping. NCIT:C19790 'Histologic Subtype' matches the concept of the molecular subtype of the tumor associated with the model.

NCIT:C14250 'Organism' is the best available parent concept for 'species of origin'. No direct 'Species' term was found in NCIT with an exact definition. This represents the concept of the organism from which the model was derived.

NCIT:C17456 'Experimental Model' covers the concept of a general label for a model type (cell line, PDX, organoid, in vivo model, etc.). No definition is provided by OLS for this term, but it is the appropriate class in the NCIT hierarchy.

label: Method
description: A means, manner of procedure, or systematic plan for attaining a result or goal.

verification.note: NCIT:C71460 'Method' is a broad term representing the concept of the method used to create the model. No specific 'model creation method' term was found in NCIT. This is the best available match.

label: Source
description: Where something is available or from where it originates.

verification.note: No specific 'model source' NCIT term was found. NCIT:C25683 'Source' is the best general match for the concept of a reference organism or cell line from which a model was derived.

label: Acquisition
description: The process by which something is acquired or obtained.

verification.note: No specific 'model acquisition type' NCIT term found. NCIT:C43384 'Acquisition' covers the concept of the process by which the model was obtained. Leaving as partial.

label: Graft
description: Tissue or organ transplanted from a donor to a recipient.

verification.note: NCIT:C12981 'Graft' covers the biological concept of graft source material (allograft, xenograft). The 'Model Graft Source' attribute records the unique identifier of the source of the graft material.

label: Genotype
description: The genetic constitution of an organism or cell, as distinct from its expressed features or phenotype.

verification.note: NCIT:C16631 'Genotype' directly matches the concept of the relevant genotype information associated with the model, including markers, background, etc.

label: Clinical Intervention or Procedure
description: An activity that produces an effect, or that is intended to alter the course of a disease in a patient or population. This is a general term that encompasses the medical, social, behavioral, and environmental acts that can have preventive, therapeutic, or palliative effects.

verification.note: NCIT:C25218 'Clinical Intervention or Procedure' is the best available match for a treatment type attribute. No specific 'treatment type' NCIT class exists that would be a direct match for the model treatment context.

label: Pharmacologic Substance
description: Any substance used in the treatment, prevention, or diagnosis of disease or used to otherwise enhance physical or mental well-being.

verification.note: Reused from biospecimen mapping. NCIT:C1909 'Pharmacologic Substance' is a partial match for 'therapeutic agent used in a model experiment'. The field records the text identification of individual agent(s) used.

label: Primary Diagnosis
description: The patient's condition which is the main reason for evaluation and treatment.

verification.note: NCIT:C202033 'Primary Diagnosis' captures the concept of the histologic diagnosis relevant to the model. The definition references the patient's condition, while the model field refers to the histologic diagnosis of the associated malignant disease.

label: Primary Site of Disease
description: The anatomic site in which the cancer originates.

verification.note: Reused from biospecimen mapping. NCIT:C158874 'Primary Site of Disease' matches the concept of the anatomic site of origin of the malignant disease model.

label: Primary Tumor Site
description: The location of the primary tumor in the body.

verification.note: Reused from biospecimen mapping. NCIT:C179451 'Primary Tumor Site' matches the concept of the primary site in the body associated with the primary diagnosis for the model.

label: Number of Days Between Index Date and Treatment Start
description: The number of days between an index date and the date treatment was started.

verification.note: NCIT:C181073 directly matches the concept of days between the index date and treatment start date.

label: Disease Response
description: The response of a tumor or patient to the treatment being administered.

verification.note: Reused from biospecimen mapping. NCIT:C50995 'Disease Response' matches the concept of the model's response after treatment was administered.
